mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of the current economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market, triggering a negative market reaction as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer and business demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average and accelerating downward indicates a supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in reduced economic output and potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is below 12-month MA and declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth trend (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity and stronger corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market discounts future growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 is rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals an overheating economy and imminent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to the inflation data.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month growth rate in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% indicates robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates stronger corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS MoM growth exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
